messages:
Priya: Quick proposal — rolling out the new fallback routing (fallback_v2) across regions. Goal: safe progressive exposure, measurable quality regression checks, and tenant-level opt-ins for our early enterprise customers. Plan sketch below, need engineering + SRE + CS sign-off.

Oliver: +1. Thinking 3 phases: 1) internal alpha (platform + infra tests), 2) small tenant opt-ins (1-5 tenants), 3) regional canary → ramp to GA. Each phase gated by metrics.

Jun: For runtime we need a perf checklist. Must run steady-state load tests with KV cache warm and realistic seq lengths. Example run: `./loadtest --model=redwood-7b --qps=200 --seq=512 --kv-warm=true` — capture p50/p95/p99 and mem/GC.

Maya: SRE asks — define SLOs and circuit-breaker thresholds now. Proposal: error-rate > 2% sustained for 2m OR p95 latency > 2× baseline for 5m triggers automatic fallback. We should also have a manual kill-switch.

Tom C: Enterprise note — two customers asked for tenant pinning during canary (they can't see degraded fallback routes). We need a tenant-level opt-out and guarantee regional isolation for them.

Priya: Draft gating metrics for each phase: 
- latency p95 <= 300ms (hosted baseline)
- error rate <= 1%
- quality eval (ROUGE/BLEU-like app metric) no regression > 2%
- cost delta <= +10%
Launch criteria: canary stable for 24h + one enterprise sign-off OR rollback. Also need runbook and rollback automation.

Oliver: Also propose flag naming and defaults so rollout tooling can target slices: `rollout.fallback_v2.{region}.{slice} = false` by default, enable via API. Keep default false in prod config.

Jun: We'll add an automated rollback hook in the canary job. Pseudo: `if [ \"$ERRORS\" -gt 100 ]; then curl -X POST https://hooks.example.com/ops -d '{\"action\":\"rollback\",\"flag\":\"fallback_v2\"}'` — ops-bot can post status to #release-war-room.

ops-bot: Canary job started: fallback_v2 -> region: eu-west-1, slice: 5% traffic. CI artifacts: build/3456, job: canary-1712067890.

Maya: Observability work: add per-tenant counters, per-route latency histograms, and a GA dashboard tile for canary vs baseline. Also add an alert for cross-tenant error spikes (aggregation level important).

Priya: Good. Action items: 1) Jun/Oliver add rollout API + rollback hook, 2) Maya create dashboards and alerts, 3) Tom coordinate tenant opt-ins and sign-off doc, 4) Priya assemble shiproom + runbook. Target start: next Tuesday 09:00 PT (window request).

Tom C: I'll coordinate the two early enterprise tenants and collect their acceptance criteria. They want tenant-pinning and a 48h quiet window after GA.

Oliver: Quick callout — do we want A/B (user-visible quality comparison) during canary or pure shadow/canary traffic? My preference: A/B on 5% for quality signals + shadow for heavy traffic shapes. We can pair eval harness to score outputs.

Jun: A/B + automated eval sounds good. I'll wire the harness to the canary job and ensure we sample traces. Also confirm freeze window: no rollouts Fri 16:00 — Mon 10:00 PT.

Priya: Thanks — will send a short agenda and add stakeholders. If no blockers by EOD tomorrow, we book shiproom and start alpha next week.
